name: actively
notiz: Marketing page mentions an Actively MCP/API but gives no server URL or docs; unresolved.

name: aiera
notiz: Docs show https://mcp-pub.aiera.com/?api_key=KEY; key via Aiera account/rep (docs being moved to platform.aiera.com), directories claim OAuth, unverified.

name: airtable
notiz: OAuth recommended (DCR); personal access tokens also supported for CLI/server use.

name: alation
notiz: URL is per tenant (replace {tenant}); Alation Cloud customers only; OAuth client created in the Alation instance.

name: alpaca
notiz: Hosted Broker API MCP only (sandbox: https://broker-api.sandbox.alpaca.markets/mcp), beta for select broker partners, super-user approval; Trading API MCP is local-only (uvx).

name: amplitude
notiz: EU region uses https://mcp.eu.amplitude.com/mcp.

name: apollo
notiz: OAuth in browser; Apollo master key in X-Api-Key header for headless clients.

name: asana
notiz: Old /sse beta endpoint deprecated; may need client ID/secret from an Asana OAuth app.

name: atlassian-rovo
notiz: OAuth 2.1; API token auth optional; older /v1/mcp users migrate to v2 by 2027-03-01.

name: attio
notiz: No API keys needed; transport not named in docs (remote URL, streamable HTTP per directories).

name: base44
notiz: Requires Builder plan or higher.

name: binance
notiz: Binance publishes a skills hub (local, API credentials), no verified official remote MCP URL; a third-party guide cites agent.binance.com/mcp/agentic but it could not be confirmed.

name: biorender
notiz: Official BioRender connector exists (Claude/ChatGPT directories); URL mcp.services.biorender.com seen only in secondary sources and help center returned 403, so not recorded.

name: box
notiz: Admin creates MCP server in Admin Console (client ID/secret); transport not named in docs.

name: brand24
notiz: Available to Brand24 subscribers; transport not named in help article.

name: brex
notiz: Beta; admin must enable 'Brex in AI assistants'; API token (Settings > Developer) works for account/card admins.

name: brighthire
notiz: Enable at app.brighthire.ai/settings/mcp; no Screen product data; API keys also exist.

name: build-ios-apps
notiz: Not a vendor product with a remote MCP server; no official remote server found.

name: calendly
notiz: OAuth 2.1 + PKCE with dynamic client registration only; no personal access tokens.

name: canva
notiz: Per-user OAuth; mcp.canva.com/mcp reported by directories for directory connectors but not seen in Canva docs; transport not named.

name: carta-crm
notiz: Carta-Doku nennt den Endpunkt; Carta CRM MCP: https://docs.carta.com/crm/guides/overview/carta-crm-mcp/ (nur OAuth, kein API-Key).

name: catalyst-by-zoho
notiz: Globaler MCP-Server (US); EU/IN/AU/JP haben eigene Domains (z.B. catalyst.zohomcp.eu); Anmeldung per Zoho-Login/Allow, Doku nennt OAuth nicht ausdruecklich.

name: cb-insights
notiz: Offizielles GitHub-Repo nennt nur den Host mcp.cbinsights.com; Pfad, Transport und Auth dort nicht dokumentiert (Details in api-docs.cbinsights.com, nicht abrufbar).

name: channel99
notiz: Channel99 kuendigt einen MCP-Server an (Testphase, Demo auf Anfrage), aber keine URL dokumentiert.

name: chronograph-gp
notiz: Chronograph betreibt einen MCP-Connector (Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity, nur fuer Kunden), die Server-URL ist auf der eigenen Domain nicht dokumentiert.

name: chronograph-lp
notiz: Gleicher Chronograph-MCP-Connector wie GP, nur fuer Kunden; Server-URL nicht offiziell dokumentiert.

name: circleback
notiz: OAuth mit Dynamic Client Registration; Standard-Scope Lesen+Schreiben, scope=user fuer nur lesen.

name: clay
notiz: OAuth 2.0 mit PKCE und DCR, Scope mcp; nur auf bezahlten Plaenen. Auch lokaler stdio-Server (clay mcp) in developers.clay.com.

name: clickup
notiz: Offizieller ClickUp-Blog: gleiche URL fuer alle Workspaces, nur OAuth, keine API-Keys/Personal Tokens.

name: close
notiz: OAuth 2.0 mit DCR empfohlen, Alternative per API-Key-Header; nur Streamable HTTP, kein SSE (Schluessel-Link ist die uebliche Close-Einstellungsseite, nicht auf der Doku-Seite bestaetigt).

name: cloudflare
notiz: OAuth Standard, API-Token als Bearer fuer CI/Automatisierung; zusaetzlich produktspezifische Server wie https://docs.mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp.

name: cloudinary
notiz: Mehrere Remote-Server (environment-config, structured-metadata, analysis, mediaflows unter *.mcp.cloudinary.com); OAuth2 Standard, Header-Alternative; /sse veraltet; Format des Headers und Schluessel-Link nicht woertlich in Doku bestaetigt.

name: codex-security
notiz: OpenAI-eigenes Produkt; kein eigener Remote-MCP-Server gefunden.

name: cogedim
notiz: Keine Hinweise auf einen MCP-Server von Cogedim gefunden.

name: common-room
notiz: OAuth 2.1, nur lesend; in einer Doku-Variante mit abschliessendem Slash (/mcp/).

name: conductor
notiz: Annahme conductor.com (AEO/SEO-Plattform), nicht conductor.build; OAuth je Plattform oder API-Token (Integrations > API), Unternehmensvertrag noetig.

name: convex
notiz: Offizieller Server nur lokal (npx -y convex@latest mcp start); die Remote-Komponente @convex-dev/mcp ist nur ein Baustein fuer eigene Apps.

name: coupler-io
notiz: Coupler.io erzeugt Endpunkt und Zugriffstoken pro Datenfluss (Custom MCP); feste URL in eigener Doku nicht gefunden (mcp.coupler.io nur in Verzeichnissen), Header-Syntax nicht bestaetigt.

name: coveo
notiz: Hosted MCP Server (Standard-Endpunkt der Default-Konfiguration; weitere Konfigurationen haben eigene Endpunkte in der Admin-Konsole); Auth OAuth oder API-Key (?access_token=KEY) laut Doku-Suchtreffer, nicht abschliessend geprueft.

name: cube
notiz: OAuth (PKCE) oder API-Key per client_credentials-Token-Endpunkt; regionale Hosts unter https://<host>/api/mcp, eigene Domain https://<console-domain>/mcp.

name: daloopa
notiz: Docs nennen Streamable HTTP, aber keine Auth-Methode (Zugang ueber Daloopa-Kontakt); Drittquellen sagen OAuth; zusaetzlich Docs-Server https://docs.daloopa.com/mcp.

name: datadog
notiz: US1-URL; andere Sites haben eigene Hosts (z.B. mcp.datadoghq.eu); alternativ Bearer-Token oder DD_API_KEY/DD_APPLICATION_KEY-Header.

name: datasite
notiz: Datasite betreibt einen MCP-Server (nur fuer freigeschaltete Konten), die URL steht aber nur bei Dritten (mcp.global.datasite.com/mcp), nicht auf Datasite-Seiten.

name: deepnote
notiz: Workspace-API-Key unter Settings & members > Security > API keys; zusaetzlich lokales npm-Paket @deepnote/mcp (stdio).

name: demandbase
notiz: Offizieller MCP-Server existiert (per CSM freizuschalten, ueber Claude-Connector-Verzeichnis), aber keine URL in den Docs.

name: digitalocean
notiz: MCP-Router; daneben viele Einzeldienst-Server (z.B. apps.mcp.digitalocean.com/mcp); OAuth empfohlen, alternativ Bearer-API-Token.

name: dnb-finance-analytics
notiz: D&B bietet MCP-Server nach Zugangsanfrage; URL nur bei Dritten (agents.riskanalytics.dnb.com/mcp), nicht auf D&B-Seiten belegt.

name: docket
notiz: Docket Demand MCP, nur lesend; falls 'docket' ein anderes Produkt (z.B. Docket Navigator) meint, nicht abgedeckt.

name: docusign
notiz: Demo: https://mcp-d.docusign.com/mcp; Produktivkonto muss per Formular freigeschaltet werden; Transport nicht ausdruecklich genannt (/mcp, angenommen Streamable HTTP).

name: domotz-preview
notiz: Anmeldung mit Domotz-Konto; Verfuegbarkeit teils als Beta/Preview bezeichnet.

name: dovetail
notiz: OAuth 2.1 ohne Dynamic Client Registration (Enterprise: eigener Client via mcp@dovetail.com), alternativ API-Token.

name: dow-jones-factiva
notiz: Kein offizieller Remote-MCP-Server dokumentiert gefunden (Factiva nur als ChatGPT-App gelistet).

name: egnyte
notiz: Aelterer /sse-Endpunkt ist veraltet; Anmeldung mit Egnyte-Domain.

name: factset
notiz: URL laut FactSet-Entwicklerseite (Suchtreffer, Seite selbst nicht vollstaendig lesbar); Auth vermutlich OAuth, nicht bestaetigt; FactSet-Abo noetig.

name: fal
notiz: Docs-Server separat: https://docs.fal.ai/mcp.

name: figma
notiz: Nur Clients aus Figmas MCP-Katalog koennen sich verbinden.

name: finn
notiz: Anbieter nicht eindeutig aufloesbar; kein offizieller Remote-MCP-Server gefunden (nur Community-Server fuer FINN.no).

name: fireflies
notiz: OAuth Standard; API-Key unter Settings > Developer Settings; SSE-Transport eingestellt.

name: fiscal-ai
notiz: Kostenpflichtiges API/MCP-Abo noetig; Legacy-SSE unter /mcp/sse.

name: fyxer
notiz: OAuth mit Dynamic Client Registration, laut Hilfe nur fuer ChatGPT und Claude nutzbar; Hilfeseite liegt auf fyxer.support.site.

name: glean
notiz: URL is per-tenant (backend domain from Admin > About Glean); path /mcp/default is the configurator example, server paths are admin-defined; bearer token only as fallback.

name: gmail
notiz: Needs Gmail MCP API enabled in a Google Cloud project and own OAuth web client (access_type=offline).

name: google-calendar
notiz: Needs Google Calendar MCP API enabled in a Google Cloud project and own OAuth web client.

name: google-drive
notiz: Needs Google Drive MCP API enabled in a Google Cloud project and own OAuth web client.

name: govtribe
notiz: Beta, credit-based; OAuth for Claude, alternatively MCP API key (sent as bearer token, exact header not documented); transport not named in docs.

name: granola
notiz: Read-only; OAuth with dynamic client registration, no API keys.

name: happenstance
notiz: Claude-optimized variant https://happenstance.ai/mcp/claude; transport not stated in docs (assumed http).

name: hebbia
notiz: Hebbia blog says a Hebbia MCP exists (Matrix, Projects) but no public endpoint URL found; likely customer-gated.

name: help-scout
notiz: Read-only for new connections; Standard/Plus/Pro plans; Docs content needs a Docs API key.

name: hex
notiz: Team/Enterprise plans; single-tenant/EU customers replace host with their own Hex URL (e.g. eu.hex.tech/mcp); transport not named explicitly.

name: heygen
notiz: All plans, uses plan credits; docs mention domain whitelisting for agent hosts.

name: hg-insights
notiz: HG MCP Server exists (API key issued by admin) but endpoint URL not public; demo-gated.

name: highlevel
notiz: Client-specific endpoints (openai/v2, cursor/v2); OAuth with sub-account selection.

name: hostinger
notiz: Remote uses browser OAuth; API token (API_TOKEN env var) only for the local npm hostinger-api-mcp; transport assumed http.

name: hubspot
notiz: OAuth 2.0 with PKCE via an MCP connector/app created in the HubSpot account.

name: hugging-face
notiz: Docs only link the URL and a settings page generating client config; auth method and transport not spelled out.

name: intercom
notiz: EU workspaces use https://mcp.eu.intercom.com/mcp; AU unsupported; Bearer API token alternative (no Fin Operator tools).

name: jam
notiz: Browser OAuth by default; personal access token via Authorization: Bearer for headless/CI.

name: keybid-puls
notiz: Could not identify vendor or any MCP server.

name: linear
notiz: Also Authorization: Bearer with OAuth token or Linear API key; read-only at /mcp/readonly; SSE /sse deprecated.

name: lovable
notiz: OAuth only, API keys not supported; third-party MCP client access must be enabled in the workspace.

name: lseg
notiz: LSEG operates an official MCP server (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot etc., licensed LSEG credentials required) but no URL on lseg.com found; aggregators list https://api.analytics.lseg.com/lfa/mcp/server-cl (unverified).

name: marcopolo
notiz: Hosted remote MCP gateway; sign-in in the client via Google, Microsoft, GitHub or email, protocol not named in docs.

name: mem
notiz: Browser OAuth flow in Claude, Codex, Gemini CLI; ChatGPT via app store.

name: meticulate
notiz: AI sales prospecting startup (meticulate.ai); no MCP server documentation found.

name: midpage
notiz: Pinned v4 endpoint https://app.midpage.ai/mcp/v4; alternatively API key as Authorization: Bearer from app.midpage.ai/developers.

name: mixpanel
notiz: EU: https://mcp-eu.mixpanel.com/mcp, IN: https://mcp-in.mixpanel.com/mcp; org admin must enable MCP; service-account Basic auth (beta) also possible.

name: monday-com
notiz: Streamable HTTP only (SSE dropped); OAuth 2.0 or Bearer personal API token; account admin must enable hosted MCP.

name: moody-s
notiz: Requires Moody's customer credentials requested from Moody's; implements MCP OAuth spec.

name: morningstar
notiz: Morningstar runs an MCP server (OAuth, license required); aggregators cite https://mcp.morningstar.com/mcp but I could not confirm the URL on a Morningstar-owned page.

name: motherduck
notiz: OAuth by default; MotherDuck access token as Bearer header alternative (see docs for token creation).

name: mt-newswires
notiz: Official hosted remote MCP server exists (login with MT Newswires credentials via connector directories) but the URL is not published on its site; aggregators list https://mcp.mtnewswires.com/mcp (unverified).

name: myregistry-com
notiz: ChatGPT plugin exists (member login) but no public MCP server documentation found.

name: neon-postgres
notiz: OAuth with plain URL, or Neon API key as Bearer header; old /sse endpoint retired.

name: netlify
notiz: Old URL https://netlify-mcp.netlify.app/mcp still works; docs page does not state auth or transport explicitly (URL-based remote).

name: network-solutions
notiz: Has a ChatGPT app listing but no public MCP server documentation found.

name: notion
notiz: OAuth default; MCP tokens (Business/Enterprise) as Bearer; SSE fallback at https://mcp.notion.com/sse.

name: omni-analytics
notiz: OAuth URL is shared; API-key variant uses https://<your-instance>.omniapp.co/mcp/https; org admin must enable MCP, transport not named in docs.

name: openai-developers
notiz: Public read-only documentation MCP server (streamable HTTP); setup examples show no credentials.

name: otter-ai
notiz: OAuth required; no public API key; plan availability inconsistent between Otter help article and blog.

name: outlook-calendar
notiz: Microsoft Agent 365 server, tenant-specific URL, preview and marked backward-compat only (Work IQ MCP is the successor); needs Entra admin consent.

name: outlook-email
notiz: Microsoft Agent 365 server, tenant-specific URL, preview and marked backward-compat only (Work IQ MCP is the successor); needs Entra admin consent.

name: outreach
notiz: Needs Amplify add-on and org admin enabling the MCP toggle; MCP auth standard with dynamic client registration, no client credentials.

name: particl-market-research
notiz: API key generated via Enable MCP in the Particl dashboard; plan with export credits required; header format from docs/mcp/authentication.

name: picsart
notiz: Browser sign-in with Picsart account, no API key; transport not stated explicitly in docs (assumed Streamable HTTP).

name: pipedrive
notiz: Official native MCP exists (Claude connector with Pipedrive sign-in), but the URL appears only on third-party directories (mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp), not confirmed on Pipedrive's own pages.

name: pitchbook
notiz: Official PitchBook Premium Connector (SSO, licence required) exists, but URL (premium.mcp.pitchbook.com/mcp) only seen on third-party directories.

name: policynote
notiz: FiscalNote announced native MCP for PolicyNote API but no endpoint URL found in accessible docs (product page returned 403).

name: posthog
notiz: OAuth browser login with automatic US/EU routing; the docs page itself does not state the auth type, which is per PostHog FAQ/search summary.

name: pylon
notiz: EU workspaces use https://mcp.eu.usepylon.com; enable under Settings > AI Controls; OAuth only, needs MCP Access role.

name: quartr
notiz: OAuth 2.0 PKCE; requires a Quartr Pro subscription.

name: quickbooks
notiz: Hosted developer endpoint is pilot/invitation-only (IP allowlist, scopes via Intuit Solution Engineer); end users get a separate Claude connector, and Intuit's open-source server is local stdio.

name: quicknode
notiz: OAuth 2.1 default; API key as Bearer in Authorization header possible for CI/CD.

name: ranked-ai
notiz: Older /api/mcp/sse endpoint still works; OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with read scopes.

name: razorpay
notiz: OAuth is documented as alternative to API keys (base64 KEY_ID:KEY_SECRET merchant token, header format not on this page); old /sse endpoint deprecated Aug 2025.

name: read-ai
notiz: OAuth 2.1; EU accounts use https://prod-eu-api.read.ai/mcp (page returned 403 to fetch, details from search excerpt of the official page).

name: readwise
notiz: Browser authorization with Readwise account; replaces older Readwise-only MCP server.

name: replayio
notiz: API key only needed for team recordings (public ones need no header); docs show raw key without Bearer; key created per docs.replay.io/reference/api-keys.

name: replit
notiz: Beta; OAuth via protected-resource metadata, sign in to Replit, no token needed.

name: responsive
notiz: URL taken from search excerpt of the help article (page is JS-rendered); needs Responsive licence with AI enabled; transport and auth type not confirmed.

name: rox
notiz: No official Rox MCP server documentation found.

name: s-p
notiz: Kensho (S&P Global) Adaptive Retrieval server; access is restricted to licensed customers via S&P Global Marketplace / commercial@kensho.com; a separate kfinance endpoint exists in third-party listings but is not confirmed in official docs.

name: scite
notiz: OAuth 2.1 for interactive clients; API key with mcp scope (Pro plan) as bearer token for scripts; POST-only JSON-RPC, no SSE stream.

name: semrush
notiz: OAuth by default; API key fallback in Authorization header for clients without OAuth; key creation steps are on the linked doc page.

name: sendgrid
notiz: Only community/local servers found; no official SendGrid remote MCP server.

name: setu-bharat-connect-billpay
notiz: Setu says it built a Bill Payments MCP server but publishes no endpoint URL or auth details (contact sales).

name: sharepoint
notiz: Generic Work IQ MCP endpoint for all Microsoft 365 data incl. SharePoint (Entra ID, tenant policy); the dedicated SharePoint server (agent365.svc.cloud.microsoft/agents/tenants/{tenantId}/servers/mcp_SharePointRemoteServer) is legacy preview.

name: shopify
notiz: Per-store Storefront MCP endpoint (replace {shop} with the store domain; requires agent profile on each request; checkout needs signed requests); Shopify Dev MCP is local-only.

name: shutterstock
notiz: Only third-party/community servers found.

name: signnow
notiz: Hosted URL documented; transport and auth not stated on that page (third-party directory says Streamable HTTP with OAuth); also an open-source self-host option.

name: similarweb
notiz: Docs require an active Similarweb API key but do not say how it is passed; third-party listings mention OAuth, so auth is unconfirmed.

name: skywatch
notiz: Public endpoint needs no auth (search, pricing, satellites); signed-in endpoint https://mcp.skywatch.com/mcp covers orders and account tools, sign-in method not specified.

name: slack
notiz: Confidential OAuth with a registered Slack app (Marketplace or internal only, no Dynamic Client Registration, no SSE).

name: statsig
notiz: V3 is current (V1 at /v1/mcp is legacy); OAuth recommended, Console API key via statsig-api-key header as alternative (key header usage via mcp-remote per docs).

name: streak
notiz: Only community and aggregator servers found.

name: stripe
notiz: OAuth preferred; Agent API key as Bearer token for non-OAuth clients (non-agent keys rejected from Dec 2026).

name: supabase
notiz: OAuth with dynamic client registration; personal access token as Bearer header for CI; optional ?project_ref= and ?read_only=true query params.

name: superhuman
notiz: Requires Business plan or higher; disabled by default for Enterprise accounts; beta status per help center.

name: taxdown
notiz: No official MCP documentation found (only a ChatGPT app listing by TAXDOWN S.L. in a third-party tracker).

name: teams
notiz: Teams chats/channels are reached via the generic Work IQ MCP endpoint (Entra ID, tenant policy); the dedicated Teams MCP server is legacy preview.

name: teamwork-com
notiz: Official Teamwork GitHub org lists the hosted HTTP server; supports OAuth2 and bearer token (token setup in the repo usage guide); transport variant not named, http assumed.

name: third-bridge
notiz: Vendor announced an MCP (client/trial access only) but publishes no URL; only third-party listings show ai.thirdbridge.com/mcp/sse, so left empty.

name: thoughtspot
notiz: OAuth endpoint; a bearer-token variant exists at https://agent.thoughtspot.app/token/mcp; transport not stated in docs, http assumed.

name: tinman-ai
notiz: Could not identify the vendor or any MCP server.

name: united-rentals
notiz: No official MCP server found.

name: vantage
notiz: Streamable HTTP with OAuth by default; API token as Bearer header also works; old /sse endpoint deprecated (retires 2026-11-30).

name: waldo
notiz: No official Waldo MCP server found (Waldo docs now live under Tricentis).

name: weatherpromise
notiz: No MCP server found for this weather-insurance vendor.

name: windsor-ai
notiz: Official docs show Bearer API key; other sources mention OAuth sign-in too; transport not named in docs, http assumed.

name: wix
notiz: OAuth sign-in by default; alternatively header Authorization: <API key> plus wix-account-id: <account id>; sse type also supported.

name: yepcode
notiz: Token from Settings > API Credentials in YepCode Cloud (also embeddable as /mcp/<token>); OAuth client credentials for enterprise; transport not named, http assumed.

name: zoho
notiz: Official hosted Zoho MCP (mcp.zoho.com, regional domains) but each server gets a unique per-user URL from the console Connect tab, so no fixed URL.

name: zoom
notiz: Meetings endpoint example from Zoom docs (SSE variant /mcp/meeting/sse); requires manual OAuth client registration via a Zoom app; other products have own URLs.

name: zoominfo
notiz: Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.0; requires a ZoomInfo/GTM.ai license; docs.zoominfo.com redirects to docs.gtm.ai.
